div.div: Activation can be rejected (a newer attempt already won) or fail half-way. The indexer rolls back the candidate under a per-Reel lock and leaves the previous index untouched, so a late or failed attempt can never damage live search (stale-outcome protection).

text.tspan: Activation can be rejected (a newer attempt already won) or fail half-way. The indexer rolls back the candidate under a per-Reel lock and leaves the previous index untouched, so a late or
failed attempt can never damage live search (stale-outcome protection).
